title: Fixed Short Hammerbeams and High Arch Portal
description: One complete newly authored fixed hammerbeam-style architectural portal. Two full grounded timber-look posts on broad stone feet carry separate short inward hammerbeams, each with a whole bent lower knee brace. Independent short upper posts connect those stubs to two complete steep principal rafters. Two high curved arch braces rise inward from the hammerbeams to a high collar and short crown upright, leaving the entire low central span without a continuous transverse tie. The open short-beam and high-arch relation differs from the old shallow hangar truss with uninterrupted lower chord and triangular webs, and from the enclosed gambrel half-loft storehouse. All member geometry newly authored, not old beams extracted or repeated web count. Three opaque constant PBR appearances, metres Z-up, horizontal bounds-centred ground origin, one complete architectural module zero scenes. Fixed artistic assembly only; no enclosing roof or building, host interchangeability, timber joinery design, structural load path, span, strength, stability, historical accuracy, manufacture, building-code compliance or construction safety claim. No rigging animation or interaction.
